resources.string: Termux is not installed. Install it from F-Droid or Google Play.
For your security, Fang Harness only runs in the official F-Droid or Google Play build of Termux, and the Termux on this phone is neither. Reinstall Termux from F-Droid or Google Play.
Fang Harness isn\'t allowed to run commands in Termux. In Fang Harness\'s app info, go to Permissions → Additional permissions → Run commands in Termux environment → Allow, then retry.
Termux blocked Fang Harness\'s commands. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Android blocked starting Termux in the background. Open Fang Harness and retry.
Open Termux once and let it finish installing.
Node.js is missing in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Node.js can\'t run or is too old. Run `%1$s` in Termux, then retry.
Fang Harness\'s Termux helper did not receive its token. Retry.
Fang Harness\'s Termux helper exited with status %1$d before connecting.
Termux did not respond in time. Open Termux once, then retry.
The connection to Termux closed unexpectedly. Retry.
Termux stopped while starting Fang Harness\'s helper. Retry.
Termux couldn\'t run Fang Harness\'s helper. Retry.
Termux was reinstalled, which removed Pi, its sign-in and Fang Harness\'s setup in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Fang Harness isn\'t set up in Termux yet. Run the setup command in Termux.
Termux\'s Fang Harness helper doesn\'t recognize this Fang Harness. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Fang Harness\'s helper isn\'t running in Termux. Open Termux, then switch back to Fang Harness.
Another app is using the ports Fang Harness\'s helper needs. Restart your phone, then retry.
